notes.title: Patch v1.3
notes.notes:
Inukari - Fateful detour is out now!

To celebrate and for all your dedication to Inukari I made this big update.
With that I bring you the new animation behind fateful detour to the origin title Chase of deception.
Cause its so much more fun to watch her in that way and to reward your dedication its here for free.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38835494/608662ecf77c56f7552b63b8ced53e6a245c89db.gif


More Features and bugfixes
 Also the improved melee and shuriken attack animation and script.
 With that the stucking recharge bug is no more!
 Enemies tweaks like attackranges and so on.
 Overwork framerate
 Tweaks on maps. Like the hills waterfalls.
 minor Bosstweaks


Hope this update inspires you to take a look again on Inukari. 
It's a passion project for myself and always a big fun.


Thanks for your feedback, your time and everything.

Kai Kieschnick <3

notes.title: Release Date on Xbox One, Series X, Switch
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38835494/9beef26b5260929d92076c5cc261ba1e4df8cf22.png

Great news!

Inukari - Chase of Deception is coming to Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S and will release on Switch eShop later this week on March 18. That makes me so much happy I can't even describe. As an single indie dev its hard to make its way through all the great games. That RedDeerGames have trust in me and my work means a lot to me and they make an awesome Job to build up the console port. To see my game on a nintendo console is like a dream come true.

Have a great day and stay health,
Kai Kieschnick
einzelartig Games.

notes.title: Inukari - RELEASE 1.0.3(1)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
currently I'm working on my new little coop project DWARVEN - Mining Dungeons.
But this doesnt mean I will watch over Inukari. So I read something about movement and
controlls and add the attack to MOUSE0/left Mouse and the Feather Shuriken to MOUSE1/right Mouse.
To give you all an alternative. And Im also think about a Input manager in future updates.
But thats for now.

Have a great sunday,
your Kai Kieschnick.

notes.title: Mini Patch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 
I made a little fix cause of some V-Sync problems.
But u must have V-Sync activated in your graphic settings. To keep the game on smooth 60fps. Otherwise I can go over 120 and it will cause problems with the unity engine Delta.Time. 

And that will cause problems with the Bugs in the Forest or with the platforms in Hills waterfalls.

Keep going,
Kai Kieschnick
Einzelartig Games <3

notes.title: Release
notes.notes:
Gosh lets be a bit sentimental, alright?
It's now over one year since I'm working on this little project with all my love and passion for plattform-games. Since I can remember back I always was into gaming. My latest back memory is while I'm sitting in front of an Atari switches all modules we have and just play video games. With the NES I fall in love with plattformers like CHIP&DALE which I'm pretty sure I can play in under 30 minutes until today xD
I also can remember back while sitting in my parents car and reading my first "how to make games book" while I was around 12 or 13. Good alt times with so many time to invest into nonsense and testing. I really wish I could have that for now. 

And now here I am. A little Graphic artist with the will to create a video game all by himself and let it go into nether. I hope Inukari bring fun to all of you. Test your skills and bring you just a good time. I'm curious about the runs, pictures and stuff that you will upload.
Let us have a good time.

Good gaming,
Kai Kieschnick
- Einzelartig Games <3
